App.name: Industrial SAS
App.description: Warehouse management system for Thai manufacturers

Transfers.title: Warehouse transfers
Transfers.handheldDescription: Dispatch, receive, or resolve one transfer with scan evidence.
Transfers.description: Move stock through an explicit in-transit boundary and reconcile what the destination actually receives.
Transfers.boardHelp: Every quantity stays attributable to the source, in transit, the destination, a return, or an owned discrepancy.
Transfers.previewOnly: Preview data only — no transfer or stock movement will be written.
Transfers.empty: No transfer is in this queue.
Transfers.createHelp: Choose a different destination and keep the source document and business purpose visible.
Transfers.approveHelp: The approver must be a different person from the creator.
Transfers.dispatchHelp: Scan the exact source stock tag. Posting moves physical stock to TRANSFER_IN_TRANSIT and retains the lot identity.
Transfers.sourceTag: Scanned source stock tag / bucket key
Transfers.receiveHelp: Record received and discrepant quantities separately. Missing or damaged quantity opens an owned case and cannot disappear into completion.
Transfers.resolveReceivedHelp: Use this only when the missing quantity is physically found at the destination. The receipt posts the remaining in-transit quantity into the selected location.
Transfers.resolveReturnedHelp: Use this only when the quantity physically returned to its original source location.

Fulfillment.title: Fulfillment control
Fulfillment.description: Allocate available stock, release warehouse work, and prepare issued packages for transport.
Fulfillment.routeHelp: Creates fulfillment demand before factory handoff. The server compares exact ATP with the ordered quantity and records whether the line can use available stock or must continue through production.
Fulfillment.releaseOrderHelp: Freeze the routed demand so allocation can begin now or after production and QC release replenishes available stock.
Fulfillment.productionRequired: Production is required before full allocation
Fulfillment.productionRequiredHelp: The recorded shortage is {quantity} base minor units. Issue the linked factory packet, complete production and QC release, then run stock reservation on this same demand line.
Fulfillment.queueHelp: Prioritize by readiness and delivery risk; commercial, warehouse, and transport states remain separate.
Fulfillment.empty: No fulfillment orders are available in this warehouse.
Fulfillment.selectOrder: Select an order to review its quantities and next controlled action.
Fulfillment.previewOnly: Preview data only — no stock or document will be written.
Fulfillment.allocateHelp: ATP subtracts live reservations. FEFO explains the selected lot order and does not silently override expiry policy.
Fulfillment.cancelRemainingHelp: Cancels only demand, active reservations, and backorder that have not entered picking. Delivered quantity remains traceable.
Fulfillment.shipmentHelp: The manifest includes issued packages only; release it after pick, check, pack, stage, and issue are acknowledged.
Fulfillment.shipmentPending: Create a shipment after warehouse issue
Fulfillment.pickDescription: Follow one location instruction at a time and record every picked, short, or damaged quantity.
Fulfillment.pickQueueHelp: Starting a task records you as the picker. Another person must perform the independent check.
Fulfillment.pickQueueEmpty: No released pick tasks are available.
Fulfillment.lineComplete: This instruction is fully accounted for.
Fulfillment.submitPickHelp: Submission moves picked quantity to outbound staging and exceptions to backorder. It does not issue stock.
Fulfillment.executionHelp: Each column exposes only the next legal action. The checker cannot be the picker, and issue posts the append-only stock ledger.
Fulfillment.stageEmpty: No work is waiting at this stage.
Fulfillment.reverseIssueHelp: Restores the exact staged quantity and consumed reservations. A different authorized person with a recently re-verified session must approve it, and the action is refused after shipment assignment.
Fulfillment.reverseIssueEmpty: No unshipped issued task is available to reverse.
Fulfillment.reverseReasonEmpty: No active reversal reason is configured
Fulfillment.reverseReasonEmptyHelp: Create an active reason code with REVERSAL scope before reversing an issue.

Transport.title: Transport control
Transport.description: Build a vehicle manifest, load every expected package, seal, release at the gate, and follow delivery evidence.
Transport.previewOnly: Preview data only — no trip or load event will be written.
Transport.noTrips: No vehicle trip has been planned.
Transport.moreRecords: More records exist than this bounded view can show. Narrow the operational queue before acting.
Transport.assignUnavailable: Create a draft trip and release a shipment before assignment.
Transport.releaseTripHelp: Release checks that every assigned shipment is ready and freezes the expected package count.
Transport.releaseUnavailable: Select or create a draft trip first.
Transport.loadDescription: Scan every expected package, reject wrong or duplicate loads, seal, gate out, and depart.
Transport.loadQueueEmpty: No trip is ready for loading or gate work.
Transport.startLoadingHelp: Starting freezes the released manifest and changes every assigned shipment to loading.
Transport.scanPackageHelp: A wrong-trip or duplicate package is refused and does not increase progress.
Transport.sealHelp: The server refuses sealing until loaded equals expected.
Transport.gateHelp: A different authorized person must verify the sealed vehicle and issue the gate pass.
Transport.departHelp: Departure starts the customer-visible in-transit timeline.
Transport.deliveryDescription: Capture private recipient evidence with minimal typing; completion waits for independent review.
Transport.deliveryQueueEmpty: No shipment is currently in transit.
Transport.podPreviewHelp: Live mode requires a private photo, recipient name, verified UploadThing receipt, and server acknowledgement.
Transport.podDrop: Drop the signed delivery photo here
Transport.podLimit: Private image; the server verifies digest and size before adoption.
Transport.podInvalid: Choose a supported image within the permitted size.
Transport.podCaptured: POD captured and waiting for independent review.
Transport.podFailed: POD was not captured. Nothing was marked delivered.
Transport.failedDeliveryHelp: Records the customer-site exception without changing stock. The loaded packages must be received back separately.
Transport.returnHelp: Receive every loaded package into QC hold at a dock or quarantine location. This posts a balanced return transaction.
Transport.podReviewHelp: The reviewer must differ from the driver/capturer. Acceptance moves loaded quantity to delivered and may close the trip and order.
Transport.podReviewEmpty: No captured POD is waiting for review.

InboundBoard.title: Inbound control board
InboundBoard.description: Track warehouse work after a purchase order is created, from receiving through quality and putaway.
InboundBoard.label: Inbound workflow board
InboundBoard.systemDriven: Stages update from recorded warehouse transactions. Open a card to complete the next controlled step; dragging cannot bypass receiving, quality approval, or ledger posting.
InboundBoard.cardCount: {count, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} on this page

Connection.label: Server connection
Connection.connectedHint: The server has acknowledged this client.
Connection.connectingHint: No server acknowledgement yet. Stock-confirming work stays unavailable.
Connection.disconnectedHint: The connection dropped. Stock-confirming work stops until it is restored.
Connection.notConfiguredHint: NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL is unset, so there is no server connection.
Connection.previewHint: Showing synthetic local data. Nothing here came from a server.

Setup.identityBody: NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY is unset, so there is no verified token and every tenant-bound function denies the request.
Setup.envHint: Copy .env.example to .env.local and fill in the values you need.
Setup.noFakeAuth: This repository has no sign-in bypass. Tenant data always requires a real token the server has verified.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.description: System state and the entry points into warehouse work.
Dashboard.entryDescription: Open the maintained workflow that clears the work waiting in this warehouse.
Dashboard.capabilityBody: Local preview includes inventory reads, master data, purchase orders, receiving, quality control, pallet and label evidence, putaway, operations counters, occupancy, and CSV exports. Real tenant data remains blocked until identity and external services are configured.
Dashboard.balancesCard: Read current balances for the selected warehouse.
Dashboard.historyCard: Read the immutable record of posted movements.
Dashboard.tilesDescription: Maintained counters for the selected warehouse, with the time each value last changed.
Dashboard.occupancyDescription: A stable location grid for deciding which aisle needs attention; colour is never the only signal.
Dashboard.noTiles: No counters for this site yet
Dashboard.noTilesHint: Counters appear as receiving, quality, and putaway activity happens here.
Dashboard.tileSuspect: This number may be low: a counter was corrected downwards. Run the verification before relying on it.
Dashboard.tileCumulative: Total since this site was created
Dashboard.receivingCard: Post received lines against an order.
Dashboard.qualityCard: Decide the inspections waiting on a disposition.
Dashboard.putawayCard: Confirm the putaway tasks that are ready.

Inventory.historyDescription: The append-only record of posted inventory movements, newest first.
Inventory.readOnlyNotice: This screen never edits a balance. Corrections are posted as reversals.

Count.csvHint: One row per line: SKU, location, lot (optional), status, UOM, minor units.
Count.batchReady: Batch {id} is ready for the next controlled action.
Count.previewOnly: Preview mode demonstrates the workflow; it does not create or post stock.
Count.planDescription: Create blind or visible count work from current physical stock buckets.
Count.queueEmpty: No released count task is waiting in this warehouse.
Count.countDescription: Claim one location, enter the physical quantity, and submit it without exposing blind system quantities.
Count.blindNotice: Blind count: the ledger quantity and any previous counter result are intentionally hidden.
Count.visibleNotice: Visible count: the permitted system quantity is shown below.
Count.failed: The step did not complete. Retry uses the same request ID.
Count.approvalStepUpHint: High-risk approval requires a different supervisor with a recent step-up.
Count.noReconciliationWork: No submitted count or approval is waiting.

Handheld.lookupDescription: Read balances for the selected warehouse.
Handheld.notBuiltYet: This task is not built yet.

MasterData.locationsDescription: Storage locations inside the selected warehouse. Read-only.
MasterData.maintainNotice: Every create and edit is authorized on the server. Each request carries an idempotency key and is written to the audit trail.
MasterData.suppliersDescription: The organization's supplier register, referenced when goods are received.
MasterData.storageClassesDescription: Storage requirements that mean the same thing at every site, such as flammable or heavy-duty racking.
MasterData.labelTemplatesDescription: Versioned label template text. Nothing here is connected to a printer and nothing is rendered.
MasterData.itemDetailDescription: Barcodes, alternate units, and lots for this item.
MasterData.itemNotFoundHint: The link may be wrong, or this item is not part of the preview data.
MasterData.storageClassesCaption: {count, plural, one {# storage class} other {# storage classes}}
MasterData.itemUomsCaption: {count, plural, one {# alternate unit} other {# alternate units}}, against a base of {baseUom}
MasterData.labelTemplatesCaption: {count, plural, one {# template version} other {# template versions}}
MasterData.codeHint: A code identifier: letters and digits, unique within the organization.
MasterData.baseUomHint: The base unit is set once, at creation: every balance ever posted is stored in it.
MasterData.trackingModeHint: Lot and serial tracking is disabled this milestone; an item in that mode cannot be received yet.
MasterData.barcodeHint: A GTIN's check digit is verified and the value padded to 14 digits. Other kinds are stored as entered.
MasterData.uomHint: The alternate unit's code. It must differ from the item's base unit.
MasterData.denominatorHint: Stored as two whole numbers so a ratio like 200/3 stays exact instead of being rounded.
MasterData.businessDateHint: A business date in the warehouse's own timezone, as YYYY-MM-DD — not this device's timezone.
MasterData.bodyHint: The text is stored exactly as entered. Nothing parses it, previews it, or sends it to a printer.
MasterData.supplierFormDescription: The code is unique within your organization. Another tenant may hold the same one.
MasterData.storageClassFormDescription: A storage class means the same thing at every warehouse in the organization.
MasterData.templateFormDescription: The version number is assigned by the server, and publishing requires a different person to approve it.
MasterData.barcodeFormDescription: One barcode resolves to at most one item within the organization.
MasterData.uomFormDescription: The factor is always expressed against the base unit, {baseUom}.
MasterData.lotFormDescription: The lot code is unique within this item.
MasterData.itemFormDescription: The SKU and the base unit are set once and cannot be changed.
MasterData.itemEditDescription: Only the name and tracking mode can change. The SKU and base unit cannot.
MasterData.locationFormDescription: The location is created in the warehouse currently selected.
MasterData.selectTrackingMode: Choose how this item is tracked
MasterData.selectLocationType: Choose what this location is used for

Purchasing.formDescription: The order stays a draft until it has at least one line.
Purchasing.lineFormDescription: The quantity is converted to the item's base unit through that item's own conversion table.

Purchasing.importBatchRefHint: Half of every row's idempotency key. It must differ from any other file.
Purchasing.importTextHint: The first line must be the header: line_number, sku, quantity, uom.
Purchasing.importPreviewDescription: This step only reads the file. Nothing is written until a chunk is written below.

Receiving.receiptNotFoundHint: The link may be wrong, or this receipt is not part of the preview data.
Receiving.openFormDescription: Choose an order, or leave it blank for a receipt with no order behind it.
Receiving.lineFormDescription: Scan or type the item, quantity, and lot. The server converts the unit and checks the over-receipt tolerance.
Receiving.fieldLotHint: Required for a lot-tracked item, and refused for one that is not tracked.

Receiving.palletDescription: Building a pallet moves no stock. It is a way of referring to lines already received.
Receiving.handheldDescription: Pick an order, open a receipt, then scan one line at a time.

Receiving.noOpenLines: This order has no line still open

Receiving.noOpenOrders: No order is open for receiving

Reports.description: Review stock balance, SKU, lot, movement, and decision-needed exceptions; export larger datasets in bounded steps.
Reports.requestDescription: The job is created immediately; the walk over the data happens one page at a time.
Reports.noJobsHint: A requested export appears here with its progress and, once finished, its file.

Integrations.title: Integration health and recovery
Integrations.description: Monitor versioned outbound events, isolate provider failures, and keep the first-party operational flow usable while an adapter is unavailable.
Integrations.previewBody: Synthetic adapters demonstrate healthy, retrying, blocked, and disabled states. Preview controls do not change configuration.
Integrations.healthHelp: Counts are bounded health signals. Provider payloads, credentials, and response bodies are never exposed here.
Integrations.emptyBody: Register an adapter reference after its provider contract and secret owner are approved.
Integrations.partialBody: At least one count reached the display limit. Use operational telemetry for the exact backlog before declaring recovery.
Integrations.registerHelp: Store only a configuration reference. Credentials remain in the approved secret store. New adapters start disabled.
Integrations.configurationHint: Name of the server-side configuration; never paste a token or password.
Integrations.statusHelp: Disabling stops new claims but never rolls back the business transaction. Enable only after provider verification.
Integrations.actionHealthy: Monitor; business users continue in the first-party flow.
Integrations.actionDelayed: Wait for backoff or investigate provider health; do not recreate the source transaction.
Integrations.actionBlocked: Inspect the failure code, fix configuration, then retry the original event deliberately.
Integrations.actionDisabled: Use the first-party record and the approved manual handoff until the adapter is verified.
Integrations.fallbackBody: An external delivery failure must never undo stock, orders, production, attendance, or proof already committed. Operators use the in-app record and an approved manual handoff; an administrator recovers the same event key after the provider is safe.

HR.title: Attendance and leave
HR.description: Record trusted work time, request corrections and leave, and review site decisions without exposing private reasons.
HR.handheldDescription: Clock in, take a break, clock out, or submit a request from one self-service flow.
HR.previewBody: This synthetic employee and team inbox demonstrate the flow. Preview actions do not store personal data.
HR.clockHelp: The server timestamp orders events. Device time is retained only as evidence, and a retry cannot create a duplicate.
HR.chooseAction: Choose the action that is true now
HR.correctionHelp: The original events remain immutable. Approval appends correction evidence and updates the day projection.
HR.leaveHelp: The supervisor sees dates and capacity impact, not this private reason.
HR.hoursHint: Required only when duration is Hours; maximum 24.
HR.privateReasonHint: Visible in self-service and HR-authorized reads; omitted from the team inbox.
HR.noEmployeeBody: Ask HR to link this login to an active employee record before recording attendance.
HR.teamPrivacyHelp: This view shows only identity, request kind, dates, and timing. It deliberately omits private leave and correction reasons.
HR.teamInboxCaption: {count, plural, one {# request awaiting a decision} other {# requests awaiting a decision}}

Production.title: Production execution
Production.description: Run revision-pinned orders from material issue through operation reporting, QC hold, and finished-goods release.
Production.handheldDescription: One connected floor flow for issue, output, downtime, receipt, and QC hand-off.
Production.boardHelp: Every run pins the released packet and reconciles target, good, scrap, rework, received, and quality-decided quantities.
Production.previewOnly: Preview mode demonstrates the workflow but does not post material or finished-goods stock.
Production.empty: No production orders at this site.
Production.createHelp: Only an acknowledged factory packet with a released BOM and route can become an order. When routed fulfillment demand exists, the production target is the recorded shortage rather than the full customer quantity.
Production.releaseOrderHelp: A different authorized person confirms the pinned revision, route, BOM, output item, quantity, and due date.
Production.issueHelp: Scan the exact available-stock bucket. The ledger moves only the requirement remainder to production.
Production.reportHelp: Record good, scrap, rework, and downtime against a released route step. Final-step totals drive FG receipt eligibility.
Production.receiveHelp: Reported good output enters the destination as QC hold; it is not available to fulfillment yet.
Production.qualityHelp: A checker moves the whole receipt from QC hold to available or rejected stock with evidence.

planningSource.ROUTED_SHORTAGE: Target linked to routed fulfillment shortage
planningSource.LEGACY_PACKET: Target derived from legacy factory packet quantity

Production.designImpactsHelp: A newer release never silently changes an active production order. Review the semantic differences while the order remains pinned to its original revision.
Production.noDesignImpacts: No open revision impacts affect active production orders.
Production.pinnedRevisionWarning: This order is still pinned to the earlier revision until a separately authorized production decision changes the plan.
Production.acknowledgeImpactHelp: Record how Production will handle the change. Acknowledging does not repin or alter the order.

OrderToShip.salesDescription: Capture the customer PO, classify every product by customer product code, and hand new designs to Engineering.
OrderToShip.engineeringDescription: Own due design work, complete the structured master card, and submit immutable revisions for independent release.
OrderToShip.factoryDescription: Use only released revision snapshots with approved files, route, quality requirements, and order references.
OrderToShip.flowSalesDetail: Customer and customer product code decide exact reuse. Geometry can only suggest a design for human confirmation.
OrderToShip.flowEngineeringDetail: Engineering records structure, route, materials, calculations, quality and private files; a second person releases it.
OrderToShip.flowFactoryDetail: The factory receives one immutable packet with SO/PO references, approved files and the released route.
OrderToShip.salesRegisterDetail: Draft and released customer commitments, ordered most recently first.
OrderToShip.engineeringQueueDetail: Priority, due state, product identity and specification readiness stay visible together.
OrderToShip.factoryQueueDetail: Printable packet snapshots; no engineering-table permission is required on the floor.
OrderToShip.newOrderDetail: Enter the sales-order identity. Customer product codes and line specifications are added after the order is saved.
OrderToShip.customerIdHint: Use the customer ID from the customer register; the server verifies that it belongs to this organization.
OrderToShip.masterCardEditorDetail: Capture the first structured row for paper, route, material, quality and calculation evidence. A verified private file and an independent approver are still required before release.
OrderToShip.commaSeparatedHint: Enter multiple values separated by commas or new lines.
OrderToShip.layerRowsHint: One layer per line: position | paper code | gsm.
OrderToShip.routeRowsHint: One step per line: sequence | work centre | operation | instruction.
OrderToShip.materialRowsHint: One material per line: item | description | quantity | unit | waste percent.
OrderToShip.qualityRowsHint: One check per line: code | description | target | tolerance.
OrderToShip.calculationRowsHint: One calculation per line: name | formula version | input name | input value | input unit | result | result unit | PASS/FAIL.
OrderToShip.addOrderLineDetail: Customer product identity controls exact reuse; geometry is advisory only.
OrderToShip.releaseOrderDetail: Commit the validated order while any new design continues through Engineering.
OrderToShip.recordRequirementsDetail: Every section needs a human confirmation and route, material, quality, print, and packing facts must exist before the design can be fulfilled.
OrderToShip.requirementsBlocked: Production hand-off is blocked until these requirements are confirmed
OrderToShip.confirmSimilarDetail: Similarity never reuses automatically. An authorized person must name the released revision and record why it is acceptable.
OrderToShip.masterCardLibraryDetail: Open a card to compare immutable revisions, submit or decide a revision, and manage its private files.
OrderToShip.previewRevisionHistory: Revision history is connected in server mode. Preview mode never invents release evidence or private files.
OrderToShip.revisionLoadFailed: Revision history could not be loaded.
OrderToShip.previousRevisionOnEarlierPage: The preceding revision is on the previous page.
OrderToShip.noStructuralChanges: No structured specification changes from the preceding revision.
OrderToShip.revisionActionsAndFiles: Revision actions, comparison and private files
OrderToShip.releasedFilesReadOnly: Released revision files are immutable and available for audited download only.
OrderToShip.draftChangedRevisionDetail: The current revision remains immutable. Edit the prefilled structured fields to create the next draft.
OrderToShip.privateFileLimit: Maximum {size}. Photos are resized and compressed before upload.
OrderToShip.invalidPrivateFile: This file type or size is not allowed for the selected kind.
OrderToShip.fileUploadFailed: Upload or verification failed. The file was not attached.
OrderToShip.fileAccessFailed: File access was refused or the object is unavailable.
OrderToShip.previewSimilarityCandidates: Server mode shows ranked released designs here. Preview never auto-selects a candidate.
OrderToShip.candidateLoadFailed: Similar-design candidates could not be loaded.
OrderToShip.noSimilarCandidates: No released designs are similar enough to suggest.
OrderToShip.similarCandidatesDetail: Suggestions are separate from exact reuse and require a reasoned human confirmation.

OperatorWork.title: My work
OperatorWork.description: Tasks assigned to you, and the queue this site is working from.
OperatorWork.caption: {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}
OperatorWork.evidenceCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing yet} one {# entry} other {# entries}}
OperatorWork.takeOverHint: The previous operator's hold lapsed. Everything they recorded stays on the task.
OperatorWork.scanDescription: Resolve the label first, check the item, then record it. Enter resolves only; it never records work.
OperatorWork.scanHint: Keep this field focused for a keyboard-wedge scanner, or type a SKU and choose Resolve.
OperatorWork.scanMismatchBody: The label resolves to {sku}, which is not the item on this task. Nothing has been recorded.
OperatorWork.scanResolvedBody: The server catalogue identifies this label as {sku}. Confirm to record the evidence.
OperatorWork.scanDuplicateConfirm: This is the same label just recorded. Check this box only if it is a real second unit.
OperatorWork.scanOfflineTitle: This scan cannot be recorded yet
OperatorWork.cameraUnavailable: Camera scanning is not enabled on this build. Use the HID scanner or declare manual entry.
OperatorWork.timelineDescription: Recorded work stays with the task across release, lease expiry, and reassignment.
OperatorWork.exceptionDescription: Record what happened, attach the evidence in words, and propose a safe next step. A different authorized person must decide it.
OperatorWork.exceptionReportDescription: Reporting preserves the observation and proposal. It does not approve or change stock by itself.
OperatorWork.exceptionResolveDescription: The reporter cannot approve their own exception. The server enforces separation of duties.
OperatorWork.exceptionOfflineTitle: Exceptions cannot be changed while disconnected
OperatorWork.attachmentDescription: Photos and documents stay private. Every download requires a fresh permission check and a one-use access grant.
OperatorWork.attachmentPreviewBody: The sample file row demonstrates layout. No file bytes exist and download is disabled.
OperatorWork.attachmentOfflineBody: Existing metadata remains readable, but upload and download wait for a verified server connection.
OperatorWork.attachmentDrop: Drop one private evidence file here
OperatorWork.attachmentLimit: Maximum {size}; photos are optimized before upload.
OperatorWork.attachmentInvalid: This file type or size is not accepted.
OperatorWork.attachmentUploadFailed: The file was not attached. Check the task lease and retry.
OperatorWork.headerIrreversibleBody: Completing this task closes the lease. Review the evidence and unresolved exceptions before confirming completion.
OperatorWork.releaseHint: The task returns to the queue with your work still on it.
OperatorWork.releaseReasonLabel: Why are you handing it back?

blockReason.claimRacesAnotherOperator: Taking a task needs the server, because another operator may be taking the same one.
blockReason.releaseChangesTaskOwnership: Handing a task back needs the server, so the queue everybody sees stays right.
blockReason.reassignChangesTaskOwnership: Moving a task to somebody else needs the server.
blockReason.heartbeatProvesLivenessNow: Keeping your hold needs the server. Reconnect, or the task returns to the queue.
blockReason.evidenceNeedsTaskLease: Recording work needs the server, because it has to check the task is still yours.
blockReason.privateFileNeedsFreshPermission: Private file access needs the server to check your current permission and issue a one-use link.
blockReason.approvalNeedsFreshIdentity: An approval needs the server to check the supervisor's sign-in.
blockReason.postingReadsCurrentStock: Posting stock needs the server, because it reads what is on hand right now.
blockReason.reversalReadsCurrentStock: A reversal needs the server, because it reads what is on hand right now.
blockReason.dispositionReadsCurrentQcState: A quality decision needs the server, because it reads the current hold.
blockReason.referenceDataStale: The information on screen is out of date. Refresh before acting on it.
blockReason.commandNotClassified: This action is not available while the connection is down.
blockReason.createNeedsUniqueTaskNumber: Creating a task needs the server, because it checks the task number is not already used.
blockReason.completionNeedsTaskLease: Finishing a task needs the server, because it has to check the task is still yours.

QuantityEntry.title: Record counted quantity
QuantityEntry.description: Expected {expected} {uom}. Enter what you actually counted; the server converts and checks it.
QuantityEntry.descriptionNoExpectation: Enter what you actually counted. The server converts it to the item's base unit.
QuantityEntry.approvalReadyBody: Record this quantity before {time}. The approval is spent by this entry and cannot be reused.
QuantityEntry.offlineBody: Reconnect before recording. The server must verify the task lease, item unit, and current approval.
QuantityEntry.noItemTitle: This task has no item to count
QuantityEntry.noItemBody: A supervisor must assign an item before quantity evidence can be converted or checked.
QuantityEntry.genericError: That is not a quantity this system can read.

error.ENTRY_TOO_LONG: That is longer than a quantity can be.
error.MIXED_NUMERAL_SYSTEMS: Use Thai digits or Arabic digits, not both.
error.MALFORMED_GROUPING: Thousand separators must be every three digits, like 1,200.
error.MALFORMED_ENTRY: Use digits, and at most one decimal point.
error.ZERO_NOT_ALLOWED: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
error.UOM_CONVERSION_INEXACT: That does not divide into whole base units. Enter it in the base unit instead.
error.UOM_NOT_CONVERTIBLE: This item does not use that unit.
error.QUANTITY_INVALID: That is not a quantity this system can read.

plausibility.implausibleTitle: That is much more than expected
plausibility.implausibleBody: Check the count. A supervisor has to approve it on this device before it can be recorded.

StepUp.title: Supervisor approval
StepUp.description: The supervisor signs in as themselves on this device. The approval covers this one action and nothing else.
StepUp.deviceBindingTitle: This physical device must be registered
StepUp.deviceBindingBody: An administrator must bind this app installation to the device registry first. The private installation value is sent for correlation and is never displayed.
StepUp.freshIdentityInstruction: Hand the device to the supervisor. They must use their own freshly verified identity; the operator cannot approve their own action.
StepUp.approvedBody: Record the entry now. The approval expires in a few minutes.
StepUp.approvedUntil: Return the device to the operator and record the blocked entry before {time}. This approval is single-use.
StepUp.rejectedBody: The entry was not recorded. The refusal is kept as evidence.
StepUp.offlineBody: Reconnect before asking the supervisor. An offline approval cannot verify fresh identity, task ownership, or this device.
StepUp.taskNotHeldTitle: This task is not currently held
StepUp.taskNotHeldBody: Take the task before requesting approval, so the server can bind the decision to the current operator.

error.APPROVAL_EXPIRED: That approval has expired. Ask again.
error.APPROVAL_ALREADY_CONSUMED: That approval has already been used.
error.APPROVAL_DEVICE_MISMATCH: That approval was given on another device.
error.APPROVAL_OPERATOR_MISMATCH: That approval was given to another operator.
error.APPROVAL_OPERATION_MISMATCH: That approval was for a different action.
error.APPROVAL_TARGET_MISMATCH: That approval was for a different task.
error.PLAUSIBILITY_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: A supervisor has to approve this entry on this device.

DeviceRegistry.title: Devices
DeviceRegistry.description: Every scanner and workstation registered to this organization, and when it last checked in.
DeviceRegistry.registerDescription: Create the auditable asset row. Bind this browser only when you are standing at the physical device it represents.
DeviceRegistry.bindCurrentHint: The installation value is a private correlation ID, not a credential. It is never shown in the registry.
DeviceRegistry.bindCurrentActionHint: Bind the app open in this browser to this physical device. Existing bindings are never moved silently.
DeviceRegistry.caption: {count, plural, one {# device} other {# devices}}
DeviceRegistry.retireHint: The device stops being usable for new work. Its history stays, and its app installation is released.
